meaning.en: A person or thing that whips.
meaning.vi: Một người hoặc một vật có đòn roi.

meaning.en: Agent noun of whip; a person or thing that whips.
meaning.vi: Danh từ đại lý roi; một người hoặc vật mà roi.

sentences.en: Dog Whipper Another career option during the 1600's was the position of dog whipper.

sentences.en: It was the dog whipper who made sure that these dogs didn't start barking in the middle of a sermon, and he would chase them away if they tried to attack a well dressed lady.
